verdict.rationale: Perplexity documents a hosted Computer MCP server (an HTTP JSON-RPC endpoint) that any HTTP-transport MCP client can use to delegate multi-step tasks. Its documented semantics cover thread_id session continuation, progress notifications, re-polling of running tasks, file uploads, approval of sensitive actions, follow-up answers and auth_required events. A runtime probe confirmed the endpoint is live with a clean OAuth challenge and RFC 9728 discovery metadata. Missing for 10: a conventional REST/OpenAPI surface for driving Computer tasks (the documented REST API covers only usage analytics), API-key auth for headless or server-side use (OAuth via a user account only), and independent hands-on evidence of a successful end-to-end programmatic task run.
